documents.title: Physical therapy plan of care
documents.text:
Patient: Maria Alvarez   DOB: 02/11/1968   MRN: 00731842
Phone: (555) 610-2284

Diagnosis: M54.50 Low back pain.
Functional limitations: Unable to lift more than 10 lb from floor. Sitting tolerance 20 minutes. Oswestry Disability Index 42%.

Goals (8 weeks):
1. Lift 25 lb from floor to waist without increase in pain, to return to warehouse work.
2. Sitting tolerance of 60 minutes.
3. Oswestry Disability Index below 20%.

Plan: Therapeutic exercise and manual therapy, 2 visits per week for 8 weeks (16 visits).
Certified by: J. Brennan, PT, DPT, 08/04/2026.

documents.title: Progress note, visit 14
documents.text:
Patient: Maria Alvarez   DOB: 02/11/1968   MRN: 00731842

Visit 14 of 16 in the current plan of care. Re-evaluation performed today.

Objective: Oswestry Disability Index 26% (42% at evaluation). Lifts 20 lb floor to waist with good mechanics and no pain increase. Sitting tolerance 45 minutes.

Assessment: Measurable progress on all three goals. Continued skilled therapeutic exercise is needed to reach the 25 lb lifting goal required for return to warehouse work.

Treatment today: Therapeutic exercise 40 minutes (lifting progression, core stabilization). Manual therapy 10 minutes.

Plan: Continue plan of care, 2 remaining visits.

documents.title: Office visit note
documents.text:
Patient: Thomas Reed   DOB: 05/27/1963   MRN: 00418806
Callback: 555-904-3371

Chief complaints:
1. Right knee pain and swelling for 3 weeks.
2. Follow-up of type 2 diabetes. Reports home glucose readings of 180 to 220.

Exam: Right knee effusion, medial joint-line tenderness, range of motion 5 to 110 degrees. Feet: monofilament sensation intact bilaterally.

Assessment and plan:
1. Right knee osteoarthritis with effusion. Arthrocentesis with corticosteroid injection performed today (see procedure note).
2. Type 2 diabetes with hyperglycemia, not at goal. A1c ordered. Metformin increased to 1000 mg twice daily. Diabetic foot exam completed. Follow-up in 3 months.

documents.title: Procedure note
documents.text:
Procedure: Right knee arthrocentesis with injection.
Indication: Symptomatic effusion with osteoarthritis.
Consent obtained. Aspirated 30 mL clear yellow fluid. Injected triamcinolone acetonide 40 mg with lidocaine. Tolerated well, no complications.
